video_title: The time Lionel Hollins smacked Marc Gasol and s*** on Zach Randolph and Tony Allen 🤯

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins on his demanding coaching style with Grizzlies players
quotes.excerpt: I was trying to breathe in their nostrils so they were breathing my air.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Did you coach like you played? Because I kind of sense you did.

text_blocks.speaker: Lionel Hollins
text_blocks.text: I was quiet, and you know I am pretty quiet. But when it was competition, I was like you Tony. I was trying to breathe in their nostrils so they were breathing my air.

quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins on his intense coaching style with the Grizzlies: I was trying to breathe in their nostrils so they were breathing my air.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins recalls a heated practice session with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: He looked at that thing, ripped up the little practice paper, put it in the pocket.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: We were down to the Clippers. He came in the locker room, he gave us all tools that day.

text_blocks.speaker: Lionel Hollins
text_blocks.text: He said, 'Turn that damn TV off. I don't want to watch no damn film.' He looked at that thing, ripped up the little practice paper, put it in the pocket.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: He said, 'No, look, he came in there, turn that damn TV off, I don't want to watch no damn film.'

quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins recalls a tense locker room moment where he demanded the team stop watching film and focus on the game ahead.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins on Marc Gasol's refusal to take a charge
quotes.excerpt: Mike Conley 175 pounds and Mike Conley took a charge and got crushed.
quotes.quote: Somebody came to the basket and Marc Gasol wasn't going to take the charge. It would have been a block, but Marc Gasol was about to take the charge and he jumps out of the way. I am pissed like crazy. After the game we come in the locker room and I said, 'Marc, I am disappointed, man.' I said, 'You had the chance to take a charge and you jumped out of the way.' Marc Gasol stopped and stood up. He said, 'What you trying to say, coach?' I stood there for a moment because I didn't have a second point. Finally I said, 'All I am trying to say is Mike Conley 175 pounds and Mike Conley took a charge and got crushed. You the biggest man out there.' And he went and sat down.
quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins recalls calling out Marc Gasol for refusing to take a charge: I told him Mike Conley is 175 pounds and took the hit, you are the biggest man out there.

quotes.speaker: Lionel Hollins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lionel Hollins on why he didn't coddle his players
quotes.excerpt: These guys aren't perfect and I don't expect them to be perfect.
quotes.quote: I used to get on Ryan Hollins about this. I said, 'Ryan, you want to write everything that happened. The skirmish and fight and pushing, that don't mean nothing.' I said, 'There is a lot of stuff that you could write that would be good in terms of true, but it would just turn people off.' These guys aren't perfect and I don't expect them to be perfect. I can't tell them what to do or how to do. I can give my advice and tell them what I think, but they are all grown men. I try to help them become more mature.
quotes.social_post: Lionel Hollins on his philosophy for dealing with players: I can give my advice and tell them what I think, but they are all grown men. I try to help them become more mature.
